tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ rtsa rlung mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: sngon 'gro rjes kyi tshig bshad bzhugs:

bde chen rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo: rtsa rlung mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod lam la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro dang rjes kyi tshig bshad: dang po bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid rgyal ba'i zhing khams la: ma rtogs bgegs su lta ba'i rigs: thams cad gdod ma'i klong yangs su: smra bsam brjod dang bral bar dengs: a ti kra ma u tsa t+ya phaṭa: ces stong zhing bdag med ngang du bgegs bskrad par bya'o: gnas lugs kyi ngang nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni: skye med stong pa chos kyi sku: 'gag med gsal ba rdzogs pa'i sku: gnyis med gcig pa sprul pa'i sku: 'dzin med klong der skyabs su mchi: zhes skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o: theg pa chen po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni: mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus pa: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir du: bdag gis byang chub sems mchog ni: srog la bab kyang bskyed par bya: zhes sems bskyed par bya'o: rtsa rlung don gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: phyi snod rtsa yi maṇ+ḍal la: nang bcud rlung sems tshom bu bkod: bde stong thig le'i rgyan dang bcas: rang rig don gyi lha la 'bul: zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bya'o: byin rlabs nye brgyud kyi bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa ni: hrī: ma bcos gnyug ma khyab gdal chen po'i dbyings: ye nyid ston pa kun tu bzang po sogs: dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs: 'ja' lus 'od skur grub par byin gyis rlobs: ye shes rang gsal 'od zer 'khyil ba'i klong: rig stong spros bral dbang chen yab yum sogs: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs: lhun grub bde ba chen por byin gyis rlobs: rang snang rnam dag mkha' spyod gzhal yas na: dbyings kyi yum chen rdo rje phag mo sogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams la gsol ba 'debs: dwangs ma ye shes rgyas par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen rang gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor na:

slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum sogs: gu ru ḍā ki rnams la gsol ba 'debs: mchog thun dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs: mtha' 'khob 'gro ba 'dul ba'i pho brang na: zab chos mdzod 'dzin bai ro tsa na sogs: rlung khrid brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs: ris bral dag snang 'char bar byin gyis rlobs: gter gnas 'ja' 'od me dpung 'khrigs pa'i dbus: ma rgyud gtso mo rdo rje phag mo sogs: bka' gter srung ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs: thar lam bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: rgyal khams phyogs med gnas kyi zhing khams na: zab gter mnga' bdag 'ja' tshon snying po sogs: grub chen dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs: don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs: spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng na: bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs: rlung sems zung 'jug rnams la gsol ba 'debs: nyams rtogs mngon du gyur par byin gyis rlobs: gdung shugs snying nas skye ba'i rnal 'byor la: mkhyen brtse ye shes spyan gyis da gzigs 'tshal: bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor mngon sum rtogs: bde drod rang dbang 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: 'byin 'jug rlung gi nus pa rab tu 'bar: zhu bde thig le rgyas par byin gyis rlobs: thabs shes dbyer med snang stong mtha' dang bral: zag med bde ba chen por byin gyis rlobs: 'khor 'das sems kyi cho 'phrul rang sar dag: bdag med chos sku thob par byin gyis rlobs: gsol ba btab pas bla ma rnams 'od du zhu nas: rang nyid la thim pas: thugs rje'i byin rlabs yon tan ci mnga' ba thams cad bdag gi rgyud la 'char bar bsam: zhes gdung shugs drags po'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab par bya'o: de nas rlung ro phyung zhing rlung sbyor la zhugs pa sogs tshar nas bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab pa ni: bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i nyams len dngos:

bde stong zung 'jug dge ba 'gro la bsngo: rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rab dar nas: rdo rje phag mo'i go 'phang myur thob shog: ces mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o: snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dge bsam blo gros can: yod na tshe 'di'i bya ba mngon dor nas: dben pa'i khrod du rlung sems zung 'jug gi: nyams len brtson rnams rmad byung skal pa bzang: gu h+ya rgya: 'ja' tshon pa rang gis so/// /
